entries.what: Arjun catches the 7:02 Tule Line from Flats Junction after buying a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sits through MWF classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Made it to class on time.

entries.what: Starts his new rule of reaching out to one alum per weekday and sends a LinkedIn note to a Bayshore alum working at a 3PL.
entries.outcome: One message sent and logged in the spreadsheet.

entries.what: Works his front desk shift at the career center, then goes home to Marisol Gardens unit 132 and tweaks his resume until late.
Takes the 7:02 north and attends Dr. Ashby's 10:30 operations management class, where the group project modeling Ridgeline-style tote flow is assigned.
entries.outcome: Project due Nov 20; he starts a task list.

entries.what: Sends another alum message at lunch and adds two new applications to the spreadsheet.
Eats his rajma-and-rice meal prep at home and splits the evening between group project notes and applications.
Morning commute on the 7:02, then MWF classes. Sends his daily alum message between sections.
Plans to do his mock interview with Lena that evening but instead spends the night asking the assistant for a fourth rewrite of a cover letter, putting off speaking practice.
entries.outcome: Cover letter polished again; mock interview not done.

entries.what: Realizes near 1 a.m. that the mock interview slipped again and makes a note to reschedule with Lena.
Takes the 7:02, sits through Tuesday/Thursday ops management with Dr. Ashby, then heads to his office hours at 2.
entries.outcome: Brief chat about the project; no letter ask yet.

entries.what: Sends the alum message and applies to two logistics analyst roles after class.
Does laundry in the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room Thursday night and chats briefly with Marcus before his shift.
Wakes to see an application cutoff passed an hour earlier because his calendar was set to the wrong time zone; it is a one-off slip, and he fixes the calendar setting.
entries.outcome: One application missed; calendar corrected and buffer column still in use.

entries.what: Rides home on the Tule Line, sends his alum message, and buys the week's chai on his tab with Anh.
Spends the evening on case team and Punjabi Student Association treasurer tasks, then applications.
Goes for his Saturday run on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about four miles.
entries.outcome: Run finished before the day warmed up.

entries.what: Hears about the Ridgeline hiring fair from Marcus and Aaliyah's chatter around the complex; he skips it but keeps the tote-flow project in mind.
entries.outcome: Notes a few details for the project.

entries.what: Afternoon at the apartment working on resume v14 and the project outline, plus the alum message.
Goes to his parents' Pell Road house for Sunday dinner and takes home a tub of dal.
Takes his mother's Sunday call about internships, tells her about the missed cutoff and the alum outreach.
entries.outcome: She reminds him to keep the buffer column.

entries.what: Meal-preps four containers of rajma and rice and lines up next week's applications.
